title: RnS: persistent local session-limit supervisor
description: Operator-directed hardening after the 2026-07-17 Claude limit incident: make the existing deterministic RnS watcher self-sufficient when every cloud agent is exhausted. Detect fresh session-limit/reset messages from live hcom transcript tails without waiting for the session to disappear, persist standby/out_of_tokens + ISO resume_after through the canonical SQLite/export path, nudge only due agents, retain bounded retry behavior, and deploy a reboot-safe user service at a modest interval (300s, not 30s polling). No local or cloud LLM is required.
acceptance_criteria: Fresh transcript limit messages on live sessions are detected once, their reset time is parsed, and the durable agent record becomes standby/out_of_tokens with an ISO resume_after without model participation.
The supervisor does not treat historical/stale transcript limit messages as fresh incidents and does not nudge available agents before a due reset.
A due recorded agent receives the normal RnS path with bounded retry; status/mirror consistency is preserved.
The installed user service is enabled, reboot-safe, uses a 300-second interval, and is verified active; no repeating 30-second poller or Ollama/cloud helper is used.
Focused RnS tests and the full MAP test suite pass; evidence documents live service and failure-path verification.
